catalog.name: The manufacturer catalogue itself — manufacturer file, the product list (create/rename/remove-product, change-product-configuration), edition/correction bookkeeping (change/remove-edition-profile, change-correction-as-of) and validation posture (change-strict-mode, change-limits). Distinct from `geometry` and `curves`, which key their own registers by product id rather than living as fields of one product record.

geometry.name: The `geometry` register — keyed `ParametricGeometry` entries (add-geometry, remove-geometry, resize-geometry, change-geometry-parameters, add/remove-geometry-connection), organized in the artifact's own `🦀️.rs` under its own `Geometry` code region, separate from `Part1`'s catalogue types.

curves.name: The `curves` register — keyed `CharacteristicCurve` entries (add-curve, remove-curve, change-curve-points), organized under the artifact's own `Functions` code region, separate from the catalogue and from geometry.
